sites.rationale: PMC9825563 names S898 in ECL4 of full-length CFTR as the insertion site for a 3xHA tag. Python confirms seq[897]='S' at position 898. The junction is interpreted as insert_after_residue=897 (H/S) because 'positioned at position S898' places the tag before S898. The site is 18 aa from TM6 (879) and 21 aa from TM7 (918). Ranked below the N901 FLAG site because the N901 site has two independent papers with surface-assay validation, whereas this site has only construct-generation evidence in the ledger. Triple HA tag (3xHA) inserted at position S898 in ECL4 of full-length CFTR by Gibson assembly (TMD2-3HA construct, PMC9825563). The phrase 'positioned at position S898' indicates the tag is placed such that S898 is the first residue after the insertion, i.e., the junction is between residue 897 (H) and residue 898 (S). Python confirms seq[896]='H' (residue 897) and seq[897]='S' (residue 898). The insert is 18 aa from TM6 end (879) and 21 aa from TM7 start (918), satisfying the >=3-residue rule. No functional or surface assay result is described in the ledger for this specific construct. [validation: not_measured; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: The TMD2-3HA construct was generated by Gibson assembly from pBI-CMV2-CFTR and a gene block consisting of triple HA, with 3xHA positioned at position S898 in ECL4 of CFTR.

sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunofluorescence without permeabilization: FLAG signal detected on wt-CFTR-expressing cells but not F508del-CFTR cells, confirming plasma-membrane display of the tagged full-length protein. Expression level reported as unaltered (PMC4405497). Channel function NOT MEASURED in the ledger quotes for this tagged construct.
sites.rationale: Two independent papers (PMC4356983, PMC4405497) explicitly name the junction as between Asn901 and Ser902. Python confirms seq[900]='N' (residue 901) and seq[901]='S' (residue 902), matching the paper exactly. The insert is 22 aa from the TM6/ECL4 boundary (residue 879) and 17 aa from the ECL4/TM7 boundary (residue 918), satisfying the >=3-residue rule on both sides. Surface display was validated by non-permeabilized immunofluorescence. This is the best-evidenced site in the ledger. FLAG octapeptide (DYKDDDDK) inserted between Asn901 and Ser902 in the fourth extracellular loop (ECL4) of full-length CFTR. Construct expressed in mammalian cells; surface display confirmed by immunofluorescence without cell permeabilization (wt-CFTR positive, F508del-CFTR negative as expected). A second independent study cloned the same FLAG-after-N901 construct into a lentiviral vector and confirmed cell surface localization without altered expression. ECL4 spans residues 880-917 (computed); insert_after_residue=901 is 22 aa from TM6 end (879) and 17 aa from TM7 start (918), satisfying the >=3-residue constraint on both sides. Python confirms seq[900]='N' (residue 901) and seq[901]='S' (residue 902). [validation: surface_only; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: Additionally, a Flag sequence (DYKDDDDK) was inserted between Asn901 and Ser902, i.e., in the fourth extracellular loop of CFTR ( Fig. 1a–c ).

literature_notes: Two additional ledger entries (PMC10622324, PMC12932761) report HiBiT tag knock-in into ECL4 of full-length CFTR with confirmed surface display, but neither ledger quote names specific residue numbers for the insertion junctions; they cannot be converted into pinnable sites. Two N-terminal mCherry fusions (PMC4356983, PMC8976878) and one C-terminal GFP fusion (PMC13056111) are disqualified because CFTR's N-terminus (residues 1-77) and C-terminus (residues 1148-1480) are both intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks.
